notes.title: Gelli Fields Star Catch Update + IMPORTANT announcement!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today we have a HUGE update to Gelli Fields for you all! I have been working on this update for months now and finally finished it. This is meant to be a better representation of what Gelli Fields will be like in the full game.

I also want to share that Gelli Fields now has a Kickstarter! You can get some really cool rewards for backing and also there's early bird copies you can get at a discount! Check out the page here

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/wonderpond/gelli-fields-cozy-farming-game/

There were SO many changes in this version of the game that I couldn't give a full changelog but I'll write down some of the main points for you!

[list]
[*]New activity: Fishing!
You can fish in each biome and the train station as well!
Each biome has rare fishing loot, so have fun finding all the different items!
[*]Star rank changes
Star rank is now more useful! There's a bunch of new amenities in the train station and even ones that relate to specific biomes. 
-Lunapon machine amenity: Increases starting lunapons and how many you get per level up.
-Corruption ATK+: Increases damage done to corruption
There will be a ton more amenities in the full game this is just a preview of what you can expect.
[*]Biome completion rewards
Now when you complete a biome your glim is converted into star rank. This means it's best to save a ton of glim right before you beat the corruption to get the max amount of star rank!
[*]Critter changes
There is now not a critter sell box, instead you drop all items into the normal sell box.
[*]Rocky Retreat changes
Rocky Retreat has been changed a ton. Here are some of the highlights
-Train carts now drive by and sometimes contain loot.
-New crop has been added to the gift shop.
-New minigame has been added: Mossy Stone Mining.
-New rare items have been added.
[*]Quality of life changes
I have done a TON of work on making sure the game plays as smoothly as possible. From changing text sizes, to zooming out the camera to where the player previously was after cutscenes I have done my best to make sure the game feels great to play!
[/list]

There's a lot more to explore, but I'll leave that up to you! Thanks so much for supporting me and checking out the Kickstarter!

-Fairlii

notes.title: Gelli Fields Kickstarter Pre-Launch + Demo Announcement and more!
notes.notes:
Hello again! 


First I want to thank all of you who have played the demo and enjoyed the game and have given it a chance. 

[h1][b]Kickstarter[/b][/h1]
I haven't posted here recently because of a change in my life. I am going through costly dental bills and have needed to find other forms of work to help pay for them. 

I wanted to create Gelli Fields without funding and release it for everyone to enjoy but due to my dental bills I decided it was for the best that the game has a Kickstarter. This crowdfunding will allow me to return back to making Gelli Fields fulltime and creating and posting content for it on Youtube on my [url=https://www.youtube.com/fairlii]channel[/url]. 

The great news is that this Kickstarter means that with the funding I can expand the scope of the game and put a lot more love and care into the project and ensure it is as great as I can possibly make it!

The funding I'm going to ask for won't be unreasonable or too much, only a few thousand but I do want to have a lot of stretch goals if we do hit the funding goal.

[h1][b]When is the Kickstarter starting?[/b][/h1]
The Kickstarter will begin around [i]January 2025[/i] but there is currently a pre-launch page up now that you can sign up for to be notified when it begins. You can find that [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/wonderpond/gelli-fields-cozy-farming-game/]here[/url]

[h1][b]Demo Update[/b][/h1]
The demo will get an update with many quality of life changes suggested by those who played it as well as a revamp to the amenity system, fishing, a more final version of the Rocky Retreat biome, and other fun changes like the log minigame being endless.


[h1][b]Thank you[/b][/h1]
I started this project years ago as an beginner dev and had no idea what beautiful and amazing game it would eventually turn into. This game is truly an amazing part of my life and I'm so happy to share it with you all. This Kickstarter will help ensure I can work on the game without worry and I will not disappoint. 


Thank you so much, 
Fairlii

If you played the biome previously and are now loading back in you may not be able to finish the biome so I suggest going back to the train station and restarting the biome. Thank you!

notes.title: Gelli Fields Farming Fest Demo!
notes.notes:
[b]Gelli Fields has a free demo! [/b]This is something I've been working on for a long time and I am SO happy to finally share it with you all!

[h1]What's in the demo?[/h1]
The demo features the first two biomes of the game! The game features changing mechanics in each biome so it's really important to highlight that aspect of the game by letting you play two of them! Please give any feedback you have I'm always looking to improve the game.

[h1]How long does the demo last?[/h1]
Even though Farming Fest ends on the 6th the demo will remain up past that date. I'll do my best to release patches for any major bugs found.

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
Gelli Fields is going to be shown off in the June Nextfest and I think I might upload a new trailer with sneak peeks at some content from the full game!

For now though I'll leave you all here with a look at a [b]future biome!
